meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: Claude 会帮你查看、添加或删除 NanoClaw agent 容器可访问的主机目录白名单，并说明每个目录是只读还是可读写。改动会在容器下次启动时生效，无需重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist” 等关键词，或想让 agent 访问某个主机目录时触发。

say.text: 现在允许 agent 访问哪些目录？
say.note: 列出白名单及各条读写权限

say.text: 把 /data/projects 加进白名单，只读

say.note: 读取现有配置后写回精简结果

howto.what_en: Claude views, adds, or removes host directories that NanoClaw agent containers may access, and reports whether each entry is read-only or read-write. Changes apply when a container is next spawned, without restarting the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or "container mounts", or ask to give agents access to a host directory.

say_en.text: Which directories can agents access right now?
say_en.note: Lists the allowlist and each entry's access mode
Validates the path, then writes the config
Reads current config, writes trimmed result
